record: Thai Ministry of Tourism and Sports destination listing
facts: Construction of the standing timber church began in 1947. The church measures 16 by 57 metres, uses wooden shingles and has a separate Thai-style bell tower.

record: Yasothon government learning-site record and map
facts: Identifies the fourth parish church, the Songyae Wittaya school campus, the paired buildings and directions to the precinct.

record: Yasothon Provincial Public Relations Office conservation record
facts: The heritage timber church is standing and was under consideration for government conservation support in 2026.
